(AI Generated).

## Freed v26.10.403-dev

Stable views during Library refresh

### Fixes

- Keep toolbar counts, search results, Friends details and Map popups visible while same-scope Library reads refresh
- Block pending or obsolete search and identity actions until their current selection and results are ready
- Retain one bounded suggestion window during refresh and preserve exact signed recovery retries after an ambiguous result
- Feed cards load image thumbnails lazily through existing media URLs and memory-pressure safeguards
- Preserve seen confirmations through bounded Desktop and PWA reads
- Keep navigation counts tied to one coherent Library state and retain verified counts while refreshing
- Show elapsed backup time in the update notification and Settings
- Keep discovered accounts out of the tracked relationship graph and open their Map location without creating a connection
- Keep mobile Settings navigation within the available screen height
- Avoid counting every checkpoint record during routine Library sync checks
- Record bounded timing for Library checkpoint preparation
- Opening, saving and processing linked articles now uses their stored article link

### Follow-ups

- Installed view stability and responsiveness still require verification on the signed build
- Existing provider sync schedules, authentication and AI preferences are unchanged
- Dormant Library authority and seen-host activation remain disabled
- The separate Saved Back repair and durable writer-admission proof remain follow-ups
- Full checkpoint preparation retains complete validation and can still take time
- Installed startup and manual responsiveness verification remain separate from synthetic benchmarks
- Priority and social diagnostics remain off; provider and schema activation boundaries are unchanged
- This build adds attribution; no reduction in stalls or CPU use is claimed
- The elapsed timer reports time spent; it does not shorten a full Library backup

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
